## Page pg1

What do you look forward to the most?

“What I look forward to the most is spending time with my family each day!”

What are your main goals for sports this year?

“My main goals in sports this year is to improve and make more fun memories with my friends on the team.”

What kind of music do you like to listen to, and who is your favorite artist or artists?

“My favorite kind of music is a mix of everything! Some of my favorite artists include Olivia Rodgrido, Noah Kahan, and Gracie Abrams!”

If you could play any role in theater, what would it be?

“If I could play any role in theater I would like to play a main role with a fun charismatic character!”

How do you motivate yourself?

“I motivate myself by reminding myself each day that my younger siblings look up to me and that I am showing them what my life is like at this age since one day they will be too!”

How is your ideal way to spend your weekend / free time?

“My ideal way to spend my free time is crafting and reading my Bible! I love to sew, paint, watercolor, scrapbook, and so much more! Along with this, I enjoy spending my weekends with my family! Like watching my siblings do what they do best! From playing basketball, to watching gymnastics competitions it’s always fun to watch them in their element!”

If you could wake up tomorrow with any superpower, what would it be?

“If I could wake up tomorrow with a superpower I would like it to be the ability to talk to animals.”
